name: rights-register
title: Asset rights register
for_each: select id,name from assets order by name

sections.title: Asset
sections.note: Internal record, not a permission grant or a sent notice.

sections.title: Permission evidence
sections.sql: select licensor,channel,territory,purpose,starts_on,ends_on,evidence_ref,revoked from permissions where asset_id=$1 order by ends_on
sections.note: Internal record, not a permission grant or a sent notice.

sections.title: History
sections.sql: select action,actor,detail,created_at from history where asset_id=$1 order by created_at
sections.note: Internal record, not a permission grant or a sent notice.

name: usage-sheet
title: Campaign usage sheet
for_each: select id,name from assets order by name

sections.title: Asset
sections.sql: select name,credit,usage_note from assets where id=$1
sections.note: Internal record, not a permission grant or a sent notice.

sections.title: Campaigns
sections.note: Internal record, not a permission grant or a sent notice.

name: withdrawal-brief
title: Withdrawal follow-up draft
for_each: select id,name from assets order by name

sections.title: Action required
sections.sql: select campaign,owner,location,check_result from campaign_check where asset_id=$1 and check_result<>'Within recorded scope'
sections.note: Internal record, not a permission grant or a sent notice.

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.sql: select note,owner,due_on,done from followups where asset_id=$1
sections.note: Internal record, not a permission grant or a sent notice.
